purpose: Retained semantic UI/HUD authoring and interaction through UiDocument without scanning the full UI implementation.
read_policy: Use these common retained-state and activation contracts first. Open Ui.hpp only when a less-common layout, navigation, image, scroll, text-input, or failure signature is required.

contracts.summary: Add retained UiElement records with stable semantic id, kind, bounds, text/name, visibility, and enabled state.
Resolve retained semantic UI state by stable id. UiElement::activationCount is monotonic retained evidence used for exactly-once game consumption.
Activate one semantic element by stable id and return structured UiActionResult; activatable buttons increment retained activationCount.
Specialize an existing non-scroll Panel as deterministic progress state with explicit value/maximum.
Mutate an already-configured progress Panel; unchanged value/maximum pairs do not advance revision or trigger layout.
Use Ui() from Game callbacks to author or mutate the same semantic UI state inspected by deterministic tooling.
